## 3. Core Operational Verticals & SAC Classification
- Vertical 1: Private Security Guarding (SAC 998525)
  - Disciplined Ex-Servicemen (ESM) marshals, civilian security supervisors, male & female security guards.
  - 2-Hour Standby Relief Replacement Guarantee.
  - Mandatory biometric Aadhaar authentication and police antecedent verification.
- Vertical 2: Contractual Industrial & Corporate Staffing (SAC 998513)
  - Skilled, semi-skilled, and general workforce for assembly lines, logistics hubs, warehouses, and corporate facilities.
  - 100% EPF and ESIC statutory remittance with zero joint labour liability.
- Vertical 3: Commercial & Industrial Facility Management (SAC 998533)
  - Mechanized industrial auto-scrubbers, 5-step closed-loop sanitization, hospital-grade eco consumables.
- Auxiliary 1: Government & Corporate Tender Bidding (GeM & e-Procurement)
  - End-to-end tender lifecycle support, GeM portal bidding, PSU rate contracts.
- Auxiliary 2: Bulk Document Scanning, OCR Digitalization & Enterprise IT (Udyam NIC 62099 / SAC 998399)
  - High-speed scanning, OCR indexing, electronic records management.
- Auxiliary 3: CSC & Citizen Facilitation Services
